description: A Mediterranean coastal terrace photographed at sunset dusk, with a breathtaking view of a still bay and distant mountain silhouettes under a soft peach and pale orange sky. The foreground terrace is paved in large-format warm cream limestone or travertine tiles. A low rough-hewn stone wall with squared pillar caps runs across the middle of the scene, serving as a boundary between the terrace and a lush planted garden edge. Tropical and Mediterranean plantings fill both sides — spiky agave, tall palm-like yucca, dense flowering shrubs with deep orange and red blooms, and silver-leafed ornamental plants. The garden is richly layered and vibrant. Two pillar-cap-mounted fixtures sit atop the stone pillars, casting warm amber glows that radiate outward symmetrically into the surrounding planting and stone surface. A terracotta-lit warmth emanates from within each, illuminating the rough stone texture of the pillar faces. The scene has a dramatic yet serene quality, with the sky deepening to a dusty rose gradient behind the mountain ridgeline and calm water surface. Camera is at standing eye-level, using a normal lens in a centered symmetrical composition looking straight across the terrace toward the water view, level pitch, with the two pillars evenly placed in the middle third of the frame. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category.
